labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

speed_mode.title: Speed
speed_mode.description: OPAMP speed mode to optimize either for lower power consumption or for faster slew rate.

external_mode.description: Configure the inverting input connection in PGA mode, allowing for external filtering, biasing, or both.
external_mode.title: External connection

oneOf.title: Non-inverting
oneOf.description: Non-inverting PGA: Inverting input connected to the internal feedback resistor. No external connection on inverting input. Positive gain (Non-inverting mode). VINPx: Input signal.

oneOf.title: Non-inverting + filtering
oneOf.description: Non-inverting PGA with filtering: Inverting input connected to the internal feedback resistor and to VINM0 for filtering. Positive gain (Non-inverting mode). VINPx: Input signal. VINM0 - VOUT: Additional low-pass filtering.

oneOf.title: Non-inverting + bias, inverting
oneOf.description: Non-inverting PGA with external bias, or inverting PGA: Inverting input connected to the internal feedback resistor. VINM0 is available for bias voltage in Non-inverting mode or to use the OPAMP in inverting mode. Negative gain (Inverting mode): VINPx: Bias voltage, VINM0: Input signal. Positive gain (Non-inverting mode): VINPx: Input signal, VINM0: Bias voltage.

oneOf.title: Non-inverting or inverting + bias and filtering
oneOf.description: Inverting or non-inverting PGA with external bias and/or filtering: In PGA mode, the inverting input is connected to the internal feedback resistor and to VINM1 for filtering. VINM0 is available for bias voltage in Non-inverting mode or to use the OPAMP in inverting mode. Negative gain (Inverting mode): VINPx: Bias voltage,  VINM0: Input signal, VINM1 - VOUT: Additional low-pass filtering. Positive gain (Non-inverting mode): VINPx: Input signal, VINM0: Bias voltage, VINM1 - VOUT: Additional low-pass filtering.
